baseline: exact same retrieval policy and snapshot, cache bypassed
treatment: generation-bound exact cache, optional caller-known packet acknowledgement

requirements.rule: Hit and bypass return identical packet hashes and ordered chunk IDs.
Every chunk reopens to exact UTF-8 bytes and matching source and content SHA-256.
Same-size source edits, changed query/filter/limits/context/policy, expiry and removed sources do not reuse an incompatible packet.
Only DERIVED_FROM, MENTIONS and REFERENCES edges; no automatic approval, claim merge, resolution or truth promotion.
No network; symlink/root escape rejected; registered source text never enters packaged evidence fixtures.
NOT_MODIFIED only with an exact caller-known packet hash in a matching context and a valid cache hit; otherwise content is delivered.
Measure retrieval executions and serialized response bytes over identical requests. Do not call these measured LLM token or dollar savings.

holdout: Unicode exact locators, changed same-length bytes and cross-context acknowledgement
limits: Small deterministic engineering benchmark; not a sealed independent scientific holdout or a model-quality benchmark.
